question: The Indian National Flag (tricolour) was unfurled by Bhikaiji Cama in:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Germany, 1907.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bhikhaiji Cama **popularly called **Madam Cama **was a prominent figure in the Indian independence movement. 
 
• The** Indian National Flag (tricolor)** was unfurled by **Bhikhaiji Cama on 22 August 1907**, at the** International Socialist Conference in Stuttgart, Germany.**
 
• The flag was referred to as the **"Flag of Indian Independence".**
 
• It was **co-designed by Cama and Vinayak Damodar Savarkar **and it later served as one of the templates from which the current national flag of India was created.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In India, the** first flag **was hoisted on** August 7, 1906, in **the **Parsee Bagan Square (Green Park) in Calcutta now Kolkata.**
 
• At that time, the flag flaunted only three horizontal stripes of red, yellow, and green, with Vande Mataram written in the middle.
